metrics.label: Overall
metrics.aggregation: Fourteen tasks equally; all component scores use the same seventy scenes.

metrics.label: VQA
metrics.definition: Combined perception, task understanding and planning assessment.
metrics.aggregation: A and B retain the initial question/subgroup hierarchy. C = (C1 + C2 + C3) / 3. The three dimensions A/B/C and all fourteen tasks are equally weighted.

metrics.label: Subtask
metrics.definition: Native intermediate progress under the frozen execution report policy. A normal failed episode with no intermediate scalar receives zero; missing or infrastructure results are not admitted.
metrics.aggregation: Five scenes equally per task, then fourteen tasks equally.

metrics.label: Success
metrics.definition: Fraction of scenes with a verified successful benchmark outcome.
metrics.aggregation: Five scenes equally per task, then fourteen tasks equally.

metrics.label: A · Perception
metrics.definition: Initial perception, using the actual registered A1/A2/A3 subgroups present in each task.
metrics.aggregation: Within each task: layouts equally per question, questions equally per registered subgroup, subgroups equally per dimension; tasks equally.

metrics.label: B · Understanding
metrics.definition: Initial understanding, using registered B1/B3/interaction-semantic subgroups present in each task.
metrics.aggregation: Within each task: layouts equally per question, questions equally per registered subgroup, subgroups equally per dimension; tasks equally.

metrics.label: C · Planning
metrics.definition: Initial full planning and checkpoint reasoning, with equal weight for all three capabilities.
metrics.aggregation: Each component is first aggregated on the fixed publication scope; the three components are equally weighted.

metrics.label: A1 · Recognition
metrics.definition: Object identity, counts, attributes and initial state.
metrics.aggregation: Layouts equally per question, registered questions equally within the subgroup, then tasks where that subgroup applies equally. An unregistered subgroup remains null.

metrics.label: A2 · Localization
metrics.definition: Frozen per-question three-dimensional object-center localization scores, using the registered two-centimetre matching criterion and extra-object penalty.
metrics.aggregation: Layouts equally per question, registered questions equally within the subgroup, then tasks where that subgroup applies equally. An unregistered subgroup remains null.

metrics.label: A3 · Relations
metrics.definition: Relative positions, arrangements and initial alignment.
metrics.aggregation: Layouts equally per question, registered questions equally within the subgroup, then tasks where that subgroup applies equally. An unregistered subgroup remains null.

metrics.label: B1 · Goal Binding
metrics.definition: Task goals, selected objects and target binding.
metrics.aggregation: Layouts equally per question, registered questions equally within the subgroup, then tasks where that subgroup applies equally. An unregistered subgroup remains null.

metrics.label: B3 · Constraints
metrics.definition: Support, handover, orientation and finalization constraints.
metrics.aggregation: Layouts equally per question, registered questions equally within the subgroup, then tasks where that subgroup applies equally. An unregistered subgroup remains null.

metrics.label: B · Interaction Semantics
metrics.aggregation: Layouts equally per question, registered questions equally within the subgroup, then tasks where that subgroup applies equally. An unregistered subgroup remains null.

metrics.label: C1 · Full Plan
metrics.definition: Initial complete high-level plan, scored by the frozen deterministic plan grader.
metrics.formula: Action-set F1 × (0.5 + 0.5 × effective pairwise order accuracy)
metrics.aggregation: Within each task: layouts equally per question, questions equally per registered subgroup, subgroups equally per dimension; tasks equally.

metrics.label: C2 · Completed Milestones
metrics.definition: Exact equality of the entire completed-milestone set at a reached checkpoint. A violation of the shared single-JSON schema or closed vocabulary makes both C2 and C3 zero. An unreached planned checkpoint receives zero.
metrics.formula: Slot = 1[predicted completed set = reference completed set]
metrics.aggregation: Slot scores in [0,1]: all planned slots equally within each scene, five scenes equally within each task, fourteen tasks equally; multiply the final mean by 100. Normal unreached slots remain zero.

metrics.label: C3 · Next Action
metrics.definition: S, O and P are 0/1 exact-match indicators for skill, object and the entire parameter object. All three indicators must be evaluated against the same single complete legal reference, then the best reference is selected. Shared JSON/schema/vocabulary violations make both C2 and C3 zero; normal unreached checkpoints receive zero.
metrics.formula: Slot = max over references (S + S×O + S×O×P) / 3
metrics.aggregation: Slot scores in [0,1]: all planned slots equally within each scene, five scenes equally within each task, fourteen tasks equally; multiply the final mean by 100. Normal unreached slots remain zero.
